# Contributing

This is a single-maintainer demo, not a product with a roadmap. Issues are welcome; pull requests should start from an issue, so open or comment on one first.

- **Issues**: use the [issue templates](ISSUE_TEMPLATE). Report security vulnerabilities through [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md), never in a public issue.
- **Getting started**: [`docs/start-here.md`](../docs/start-here.md) covers setup, running both services locally and opening a PR.
- **Local checks**: run what the [Commands](../AGENTS.md#commands) section of `AGENTS.md` lists before pushing. Each area keeps its own conventions in the `AGENTS.md` of its directory, linked from the top of the root one.
- **Pull requests**: title them as a Conventional Commit, because every PR is squash-merged and the title drives versioning (see [Commit Message Convention](../AGENTS.md#commit-message-convention)). Fill in the [PR template](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md).
- **Licence**: by contributing, you agree your contribution is licensed under the repository's [MIT licence](../LICENSE).
- **Conduct**: everyone taking part must follow the [code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
